quotes.text: filter-continue-execution = Applying filter { $filterName } failed. Would you like to continue applying filters?

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Fluent continuation prompt formats filter-continue-execution with filterName, initializes returnVal to false and returns the value supplied by Confirm. Missing current filter, formatting failure or absence of a usable dialog does not produce a true continuation result. At the original landing the dialog came from m_msgWindow's docShell; fixed accepted source later uses the most recent window through nsIPromptService. Caller window guards and end/next-filter decisions remain separate from the helper's Boolean. No prompt or filter operation was run.
title: Filter continuation uses the confirmation Boolean rather than localization success
